item.title: Monkey Island: all 13 versions side by side
item.description:
📝 TXT About these screens Every screen was captured in ScummVM, except the Atari ST monochrome screens, which come from the Hatari emulator. 35 here for 4:3, shared under the same licence. Each version is drawn from its native pixels on the monitor closest to its own, with a whole number of screen pixels for every scanline where the size allows.
🔗 Read more: https://monkeyisland.pages.dev/
